name: mcnamee-mcp-servers
description: Single-file MCP servers for working with Word, Excel, Outlook, Confluence, Jira, PDFs and a local RAG knowledge base. Each plugin bundles one server with its matching skill, so it installs and updates as one unit - including fully offline.

plugins.name: ms-word
plugins.description: Read, edit and create Word .docx files - including Word tracked changes, native styles and filling out templates.

plugins.name: ms-excel
plugins.description: Read and analyse Excel workbooks. Read-only; parses .xlsx directly so Excel is not required.

plugins.name: ms-outlook
plugins.description: Read-only access to local classic Outlook mail and calendar via COM. Windows only; requires pywin32.

plugins.name: confluence
plugins.description: Search and read Confluence pages, optionally mirroring them to Markdown for a local RAG knowledge base.

plugins.name: jira
plugins.description: Query Jira issues, sprints and projects. Read-only (Jira Data Center v2 REST API).

plugins.name: knowledge-base
plugins.description: True RAG over your own Markdown docs: a local ChromaDB vector index plus your embeddings API. Requires chromadb.

plugins.name: pdf-to-md
plugins.description: Convert PDFs to Markdown with tables preserved, for feeding a local knowledge base. Requires pymupdf.
